item.title: Ācta Diurna · Diēs Dominicus, VI Īd. Nov. (Sun 8 Nov 2026)
item.description: Canberra 3–21° and sunny; the RBA's fifth rate rise (4.85%, an 18-year high) and Angus Taylor: 'homegrown' inflation; US midterms: Republicans lose both houses, Stephen Miller new chief of staff, Hegseth under fire; Iran's offer via Qatar, tankers hit mines in Hormuz; Karl Bushby home after 28 years on foot; Opīniō: Judith Sloan on Labor's $560m grants; Nerva born, AD 30. English headlines, Latin, then the Latin again. Sources: Bureau of Meteorology; ABC News (4 Nov); The Spectator Australia; Yahoo News (6 Nov); Times of Israel (6 Nov); ITV News (2 Nov).
